newsitem.title: USA: World Bank lends $35 mln for West Bank, Gaza plans.
newsitem.headline: World Bank lends $35 mln for West Bank, Gaza plans.

text.p: The World Bank said on Wednesday its board had approved two loans to the Palestinian Authority totalling $35 million to help foster housing and private sector investment in Gaza and the West Bank.

A $25 million credit will bolster financing of the authority's Housing Project, while $10 million will help the Authority encourage private sector investment in the areas and by providing insurance against political and war risks, including expropriation, the bank said in a statement.
The loans are both for 40 years with a 10-year grace period before repayment starts.

Under the housing project, a private company called the Secondary Mortgage Facility has been set up to provide capital to help commercial banks manage risks by refinancing their long-term mortgage loans and helping share credit risk.
The project will also encourage low-cost house building.
